topics.label: Egocentric video datasets and benchmarks
topics.summary: The large first-person video corpora that define the tasks, annotations, and scale of modern egocentric understanding.

claims.title: Scaling Egocentric Vision: The EPIC-KITCHENS Dataset
claims.rationale: The first large unscripted egocentric kitchen dataset; established verb-noun action labels and the object/hand-centric benchmarks most later work builds on.

claims.title: Ego4D: Around the World in 3,000 Hours of Egocentric Video
claims.rationale: Massive-scale, multi-site egocentric video with hand-object, forecasting, and episodic memory benchmarks; the de facto pretraining and evaluation source for egocentric models.

claims.title: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
claims.rationale: Paired ego and exo views of skilled manipulation with 3D hand/body pose annotations; directly relevant to using human skill video as robot training data.

claims.title: An Outlook into the Future of Egocentric Vision
claims.rationale: Broad survey of egocentric vision tasks, datasets, and open problems; a map of the field to read alongside the datasets.

topics.label: Hand-object interaction detection in egocentric video
topics.summary: 2D methods that localize hands, detect contact, and ground interaction regions in first-person frames.

claims.title: Understanding Human Hands in Contact at Internet Scale
claims.rationale: The 100DOH dataset and hand-contact detector (hand side, contact state, held object); the hand detector reused by most later hand-object and robot-from-video pipelines.

claims.title: Grounded Human-Object Interaction Hotspots from Video
claims.rationale: Learns where on objects people interact from weakly labeled egocentric video; the origin of the affordance-hotspot idea later used for robot affordances.

claims.title: Fine-Grained Egocentric Hand-Object Segmentation: Dataset, Model, and Applications
claims.rationale: EgoHOS gives pixel-level hand and interacting-object masks across egocentric datasets; useful for masking, segmentation, and object-centric features in robot pipelines.

topics.label: 3D hand pose and hand-object reconstruction
topics.summary: Parametric hand models and monocular methods for recovering 3D hand and manipulated-object pose from images and video.

claims.title: Embodied Hands: Modeling and Capturing Hands and Bodies Together
claims.rationale: Introduces MANO, the parametric hand model that nearly every 3D hand pose estimator and hand-retargeting method outputs.

claims.title: Learning Joint Reconstruction of Hands and Manipulated Objects
claims.rationale: First end-to-end joint hand and object mesh reconstruction with contact losses; sets up the hand-object reconstruction problem and the ObMan synthetic data.

claims.title: DexYCB: A Benchmark for Capturing Hand Grasping of Objects
claims.rationale: Multi-view hand-object grasp benchmark with YCB objects; its robotics-oriented design (handover, grasp planning tasks) bridges pose estimation and manipulation.

claims.title: Reconstructing Hands in 3D with Transformers
claims.rationale: HaMeR: a ViT-based MANO regressor trained on pooled datasets that is robust in-the-wild and in egocentric views; the current default tool for extracting hand pose from human video.

topics.label: Visual representations pretrained on human video
topics.summary: Self-supervised visual encoders trained on egocentric and human video that transfer to robot control.

claims.title: R3M: A Universal Visual Representation for Robot Manipulation
claims.rationale: Pretrains a visual encoder on Ego4D with time-contrastive and language-alignment losses, then shows strong data-efficient imitation; the canonical egocentric-video-to-robot representation paper.

claims.title: Masked Visual Pre-training for Motor Control
claims.rationale: MAE pretraining on in-the-wild and egocentric hand-object images yields frozen encoders that transfer to motor control; a contrasting, simpler recipe to R3M.

topics.label: Affordances and hand retargeting from human video to robots
topics.summary: Extracting contact points, trajectories, and hand poses from human video and mapping them to robot grippers and dexterous hands.

claims.title: Affordances from Human Videos as a Versatile Representation for Robotics
claims.rationale: VRB trains a contact-point and post-contact trajectory predictor from Ego4D/EPIC hand tracks and uses it for robot exploration, imitation, and RL; ties egocentric HOI detection directly to robot learning.

claims.title: DexMV: Imitation Learning for Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos
claims.rationale: Full pipeline: 3D hand-object pose estimation from human video, kinematic retargeting to a multi-finger hand, then demonstration-augmented RL; the reference design for pose-based human-to-robot transfer.

claims.title: Robotic Telekinesis: Learning a Robotic Hand Imitator by Watching Humans on YouTube
claims.rationale: Learns human-to-robot hand retargeting from uncurated internet video, enabling low-cost teleoperation; shows how far monocular hand pose can carry dexterous control.

topics.label: Scaling imitation learning with egocentric human data
topics.summary: Recent systems that co-train robot policies on wearable or egocentric human demonstrations collected at scale.

claims.title: EgoMimic: Scaling Imitation Learning via Egocentric Video
claims.rationale: Co-trains a bimanual policy on Aria-glasses human demonstrations and robot data with a unified hand/end-effector action space; a concrete recipe for egocentric video as a first-class training source.

claims.title: DexCap: Scalable and Portable Mocap Data Collection System for Dexterous Manipulation
claims.rationale: Portable hand mocap plus egocentric RGB-D capture for dexterous-hand imitation; contrasts sensor-based hand capture with vision-only pose estimation.

claims.title: Learning by Watching: A Review of Video-based Learning Approaches for Robot Manipulation
claims.rationale: Survey organizing video-based robot learning into representation, affordance, retargeting, and policy-learning approaches; useful consolidation after the core papers.
